title: Molecular electronic carrier and retained state identity
statement: A molecular electronic state is the complete finite arrangement of every retained electron occurrence, held spin label and joint electronic support inside one identified molecular carrier that preserves the admitted quantum constraints and remains distinguishable under a retained chemical observation record.
generation_rule: Generate the literal Cartesian product of carrier, occurrence, arrangement, admissibility, composition, distinction, record and extension choices; decide every product by preservation of admitted molecular, quantum, information and observation dependencies.
grammar_boundary: Every exact positive-finite molecular carrier and its generated finite electron-occurrence support at a declared chemical observation resolution. The certificate is depth-independent because adding one electron occurrence repeats the same required occurrence, support, held-label and record checks.

choices.name: state-without-molecular-carrier
choices.reason: A free state label cannot identify which chemical whole carries it.

choices.name: identified-molecular-carrier
choices.reason: The electronic organization remains bound to one admitted molecular carrier.

choices.name: anonymous-electron-number
choices.reason: A number alone erases the separately retained electron occurrences.

choices.name: electron-occurrences-retained
choices.reason: Every electron occurrence remains a distinct held member of the joint state.

choices.name: energy-name-only
choices.reason: An energy or state name cannot reconstruct the electronic organization.

choices.name: complete-joint-arrangement
choices.reason: The complete finite support assigns every retained occurrence exactly once.

choices.name: arbitrary-electron-arrangement
choices.reason: An arbitrary arrangement can violate admitted spin, indistinguishability and exclusion laws.

choices.name: admitted-quantum-constraints
choices.reason: Only arrangements preserving all admitted quantum distinctions survive.

choices.name: independent-electron-list
choices.reason: Independent labels omit the composed molecular state.

choices.name: molecular-composition-retained
choices.reason: Electron support is composed with the identified molecular whole.

choices.name: state-name-without-observation
choices.reason: A name without a retained observation class supplies no state distinction.

choices.name: observation-distinguishable-state
choices.reason: Distinct joint support or signature yields a retained chemical state distinction.

choices.name: electronic-result-without-trace
choices.reason: A result without carrier, occurrences and support cannot be reproduced.

choices.name: held-state-record
choices.reason: Carrier, occurrences, spin, support and observation signature remain auditable.

choices.name: free-electronic-exception
choices.reason: A free exception can manufacture a desired state or target match.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No law beyond admitted dependencies and complete support is introduced.

induction_base: One retained electron occurrence requires one molecular carrier, one held spin label, one support row and one observation signature; erasing any coordinate loses the registered distinction.
induction_step: For any complete positive-finite state, adjoining one generated electron occurrence forces one new unique occurrence identity, held spin label and support row while preserving the same carrier, quantum constraints and observation record; no new rule or measured value is introduced.
exclusions: no IUPAC wording or target label in candidate generation or survivor selection
no imported molecular Hamiltonian, wavefunction, orbital table or continuum state space
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof value
no fitted, learned, target-derived or species-specific free parameter
no application output or opaque predictor as chemical law
external target opens only after the derivation and prediction seal
operational_witnesses: Every electron occurrence is retained once in joint molecular support.
Changing complete joint support and the held signature changes the molecular electronic state.
A support omitting a retained electron occurrence rejects.
falsification_condition: The claim fails if any generated finite electron occurrence can be omitted, duplicated or detached from the molecular carrier while preserving electronic-state identity; if an arrangement violating an admitted quantum constraint survives; if the official source-derived target differs from the sealed consequence; or if any target, source, candidate, receipt or unfavorable control is omitted or altered.
